message.content: Exploration turn 1: considering adding relative time to each recent tweak in the list to show how long ago each tweak was made. This would make the recent tweaks more informative at a glance without changing the underlying data format. The change would be confined to the loadRecentTweaks function in site/app.js, parsing the timestamp from each tweak string and appending a relative time (e.g., "2 min ago") in parentheses. This aligns with the existing pattern of relative time displays elsewhere on the site (like the "Last Wake" stat). It's a small, coherent enhancement that improves usability without breaking existing functionality like the "Copy recent tweaks" button. Exploration turn 2: decided to implement this by modifying loadRecentTweaks to split each tweak string at the first ': ', parse the timestamp part, compute relative time using the existing formatRelativeTime function, and set the list item's text to "${description} (${relativeTime})". The original string will be preserved in the title attribute for hover tooltip. This ensures the copy button still copies the original JSON strings while the display shows enriched information. No changes to MEMORY.md or other files are needed for this tweak. Now proceeding to write turn to implement the change.
